blocks.html: The details of the received item to be removed.

types.name: return_id
types.description: The ID of the return to remove the item from.

types.name: action_id
types.description:
The ID of the action associated with the item to remove.
Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions.
You can find an action with the name `RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM` using its `action` property,
and use the value of its `id` property.
